settings.title: What's included
settings.content: Three pieces, one meaningful place: a four-sided bar necklace, adjustable cuff bracelet, and 4 mm flat-band coordinates ring. Choose gold or silver and a whole ring size from 5 through 10.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Enter one verified coordinate pair or use the separate-piece fields for different places. 2. Review the necklace, bracelet, and ring layouts in the set preview. 3. Check every engraving and the ring size in the cart before checkout.
